|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett]], under the original title. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-01-The_Mandalorian_Father_Of_Fett-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The release-sheet slip shows the original text (see [[The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett]]); the current text is [[Jango Fett, The Assassin]] (PC-E2, retitled Jango Fett, The Assassin).
* '''Original''' ([[The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett]]): printed as “•The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett” on the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012), p. 3<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. Adds one battle destiny. SD-17 Homing Missile may deploy on (and is a matching weapon for) him, fires for free, and when fired may go to Lost Pile instead. While piloted by two Fetts (unless your [Virtual Block 4] objective on table), Slave I is immune to attrition < 9.” Lore: “Trade Federation assassin and scout.” From 12 December 2012 to 11 January 2013 the Virtual Block 8 card list (VBlock8Type) printed this wording again, still titled The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett<ref name="cl-back-jango">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>; a reprint of the original text, not a separate version.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list, still titled The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett, rewrote the text (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text)<ref name="cl-mid-jango">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21]; Virtual Master list (VMasterType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. Adds one battle destiny. SD-17 Homing Missile may deploy on (and is a matching weapon for) him, fires for free, and when fired may go to lost pile instead. While piloting Slave I with Boba (unless your [Virtual Block 4] objective on table), it is immune to attrition <9.” The Virtual Block 8 list (VBlock8Type) printed this rewording on 21 July 2012; from 12 December 2012 it printed the sheet wording again (with “Lost Pile”), while the Virtual Master list (VMasterType) kept the rewording to 11 January 2013. The capital in “lost pile” alone would wait for a ruling; the rewording of the last sentence makes this a version. No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-01-The_Mandalorian_Father_Of_Fett-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Jango Fett, The Assassin]]): the title changed to “•Jango Fett, The Assassin”. The PC website card list shows the new title by 13 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-new-jango">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313222931/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-03-13], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429063548/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-04-29]; VMasterType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314003713/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-03-14], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429102413/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive; these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, PDF page 10)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints the card as •Jango Fett, The Assassin with the sheet's game text. The lore changed to “Trade Federation. Scout.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-9-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-jangofetttheassassin-pre.gif]], undated) print it.
